## Question before the house

- How much computer music can I get out of really tiny computers?
- Wait? How tiny?
    - Raspberry Pi Pico W (micro-controller)
    - Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W (micro-controller)
    - Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W (small single-board computer)
- The prime directives:
    - Develop interactively ***for*** the device ***on*** the device
    - Command line / terminal user interface

## Sounds like a perfect application for Forth!
